dataset.name: BNCI2014_001 / BCI Competition IV Dataset 2a
dataset.scope: subject-specific session-T training and session-E evaluation

config.bootstrap_scheme: stratified by (E source run x true class), paired across decoders
config.permutation_scheme: true labels permuted within each source E run against frozen predictions; statistic = plug-in MI; Phipson-Smyth (1+exceed)/(B+1)

published_benchmark_context.comparability_note: Ang et al. used a causal, time-resolved competition evaluation scored by maximum kappa; these values are context, not fixed-window acceptance targets.

evaluation_cycle.scope: all six task runs, all scheduled trials, before artifact exclusion; within-run inter-trigger differences (fixed cue offset cancels); inter-run gaps excluded by run identity

training.convention: trigger at zero-based s0; cue = s0+500; epoch samples [s0+625, s0+1125] inclusive; 501 samples; 250 Hz

evaluation.convention: trigger at zero-based s0; cue = s0+500; epoch samples [s0+625, s0+1125] inclusive; 501 samples; 250 Hz

primary.name: fixed-window OVR-CSP + shrinkage LDA
